result.summary: Found 4 issues: content is cut off at the right edge of the screen in multiple sections, and there is a bottom navigation bar element that appears malformed.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll list cuts off the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccolo) at the edge of the screen with no visual indication of scrollability
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek of the next card with a gradient fade or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrolling is available

issues.description: The category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off at the right edge, showing a partially visible additional chip
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay at the edge or ensure consistent padding to indicate more categories are scrollable

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar's middle icon (search/reorder icon) appears as an unusual horizontal bar shape rather than a standard icon, inconsistent with the home and profile icons
issues.suggestion: Replace with a properly rendered, consistent icon matching the style of the other navigation icons

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated/cut off due to the card being cut at the screen edge
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis or resize card layout so text isn't abruptly cut by the screen boundary
